name: 33019 · Hollywood, FL
findings: ZIP 33019 (Hollywood) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33019 (Hollywood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33019 (Hollywood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
